narrative:
Fayette County has 16,893 registered voters, with 56.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.4%, a pronounced Republican lean of 24.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants.
